addition: Formatting evidence formatBoundaries gives the end of the preceding non-whitespace formatting stretch and the start of the following non-whitespace stretch; the gap between them may contain whitespace. These are measurements, not required heading boundaries. Decide the extent from the source and its context. A headingExtent must not begin or end with whitespace. Its text must be the exact source substring at its UTF-16 start and exclusive end; do not include a whitespace gap at the boundary.
trimOnly: For each headingExtent, the text must be the exact source substring at its UTF-16 start and exclusive end, and must not begin or end with whitespace. Decide the extent yourself from the source and context.
note: GROUP and PLACE remain baseline; instruction-only references a field intentionally absent, trim-only does not.
